name: Enlightenment
concept: The Enlightenment desktop as a chat client: every Element panel becomes an E window with a title bar, the space panel becomes the shelf/pager and the composer the shelf below it. The pure stages reproduce verified palettes from the theme sources (E16 BrushedMetal-Tigert pixmaps, the E17 0.17 dark theme, and EFL's current colorclasses.edc with #3399FF), the past stage is 1999 brushed aluminium on turquoise, the exciting stages are three 'really nice dark, coloured' mashups (aurora, ember, neon steel), and the usable stage keeps the E look but tunes contrast, focus and motion for long chat sessions.

sources.title: E16 themes repo (BrushedMetal-Tigert, BlueSteel, Ganymede, ShinyMetal) — pixmaps sampled for hex values; e16 licence (MIT-style)
Enlightenment 0.17.6 default theme (data/themes/*.edc + img, BSD-2) — E17 gradients and #3399FF glow sampled
EFL elementary theme colorclasses.edc (current E / E-current core palette, :selected #3399FF)
Enlightenment home page screenshots (E 0.25 era, raster, 2021-12-13)
MokshaRadiance (Bodhi/Moksha theme, BSD-2) — rad_conf.edc colour macros
DejaVu fonts (Bitstream Vera licence + public domain)
Fontsource (OFL webfont builds: Titillium Web, Saira Semi Condensed, Exo 2, IBM Plex Sans, Share Tech Mono, Silkscreen)

limits: Element Call / Jitsi / widget iframes only receive light|dark; every E variant frames them in its window border but the content stays Element-dark (e-daylight: Element-light by day).

Compound icons are inline currentColor SVGs: recoloured (and glowing via drop-shadow on hover/focus), not replaced by E17 bitmap icons; only the header window-button trio and the space-panel logo are our own SVGs.
No real window manager behaviour: E16 window shading, E17 compositor zoom/flip effects and gadget dragging are imitated with CSS animations on dialogs/menus only; nothing is draggable.
Notification badges re-declare cpd-theme-light; tokens are set on [class*=cpd-theme-] and badges get direct [class*=_notificationBadge_] rules.
Avatar images, emoji, chat effects canvas, maps and the pre-module spinner cannot take the glow/metal treatment (frames only).
Lucida (E16 X11 core font) is proprietary: referenced via local(), DejaVu Sans bundled as fallback.
E-current is not pixel-faithful to raster's newest theme (it changes almost monthly); we follow the colorclasses.edc palette and the 0.25+ screenshots.
Glow-heavy variants keep effects off timeline tiles (performance rule): glow lives on selection, focus, header, composer and badges only.

variants.name: E16 · BrushedMetal-Tigert
variants.tagline: 1999's default E16 theme: brushed aluminium window frames on a deep turquoise desktop.

fonts.ui: Lucida Grande / Lucida Sans (local) → DejaVu Sans, 13px; bold for titles
fonts.display: Lucida bold → DejaVu Sans Bold (title bars); Silkscreen for pager/iconbox micro-labels

shape.shadow: none; 1px #FEFEFE inner top highlight + 1px #121212 outline (E16 border pixmaps)

variants.texture: brushed-metal (self-made brushed-aluminium.png, Tigert light_brushed.png optional) + turquoise desktop (tigert-turquoise-bg.jpg / CSS gradient #1D5A5A→#346F6E)
variants.motion: Almost none, like 1999: instant hover swaps (pressed = inverted bevel), window-shade roll-up animation (120 ms scaleY) on dialogs closing; disabled under reduced motion.
signature: Every panel is an E16 window: 4px aluminium frame, 19–23px title bar with Tigert bronze gem buttons (menu left, min/max/close right)
Turquoise desktop (#1D5A5A→#346F6E vertical gradient, like dark_vertical_gradient_brushed.png) behind the timeline with white text and #88DDDD links (Edoc help colours)
Active title bar #A7A7A6 aluminium with black bold title, inactive/unfocused panels drop to #767675
Sticky/selected rows in Tigert's turquoise sticky-title tint (#93B0AE, text #000)
Space panel as E16 pager: tiny square 'desktops' with teal windows (#1D3F3F) in a metal frame, Silkscreen labels

regions.names-avatars: avatars square (radius 0) with 1px black outline + white inner bevel; usernames bright pastel decoratives (cyan/sand/lilac) tuned for teal
regions.composer: metal bar like the E16 iconbox: aluminium with an inset (bevel-in) white-ish entry field #EDEEEE, black text; send = gem button
regions.rightpanel: second E16 window: metal frame and title bar, inner content on light metal (#D9DCDE) with black text
regions.buttons: raised bevel: #CFD3D6→#8E9398 gradient, 1px #2B2F33 outline, inset 1px #F1F3F4 / -1px #5A5F64; pressed inverts; primary gets teal face (#9BB9B7, Tigert dialog button1)
regions.inputs: sunken bevel (#5A5F64 top-left, #F1F3F4 bottom-right), white field, black text, teal caret
regions.dialogs: E16 dialog window: metal title bar with gem buttons, body light_brushed aluminium, teal-faced primary buttons; backdrop = teal at 60%
regions.menus: E16 menu style: metal panel, 1px black outline, highlighted item = teal #346F6E with white text; tooltips = pale yellowish metal (#E7E3D2) with black text, square
regions.settings: dialog chrome as above; tab list as metal toolbar with bevelled tab buttons; panels on #D9DCDE with black text
regions.auth: teal desktop full-bleed with Tigert 'Brushed Metal' title image and a centred E16 window for the form
regions.scrollbars: 14px metal trough (sunken) with bevelled aluminium thumb carrying 3 etched grip lines; no arrows
regions.focus: 2px dotted #000 outline on metal, 2px solid #88DDDD outline on teal (both ≥3:1), offset 1px
regions.badges: square bevel pills: count = black on #C8C8C6 with 1px outline; mention = white on #A0281E bevel
regions.code: Eterm-style #0E2A2A panel, #CFE3E2 text, DejaVu Sans Mono, hljs keywords #88DDDD, strings #D9C08A, comments #7FA3A1
regions.iframes: Element dark; framed by a 4px metal border + title bar strip
regions.icons: icons black (#1A1A1A) on metal, #CFE3E2 on teal; no glow
regions.motion: no transitions except shade roll-up on close and 80 ms bevel press

variants.enhancer: Optional: E16 'Epplet' clock (E-Clock style analog face in metal bezel) mounted in the space-panel footer; adds data-tl-e16-focus to the panel that holds keyboard focus so its title bar turns 'active' (#A7A7A6) while the others go inactive (#767675).
